{"type":"thought","data":"Synthesizing the fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability for the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Goiás EC market."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFair probability estimates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" range from 51% to 56%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle implies 58.1%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Bet365 implies 58.8%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the average of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"42 books implies 54%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The foot.be algorithm"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is conservative at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"51%. Flashscore US moneyline"}
{"type":"thought","data":" -175 implies 63.7% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"but is inflated by juice."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBookmaker.eu implies"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 58.5% for Goiás, and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Smarkets implies 56.1%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Polymarket shows Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.605, roughly four"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to six points above"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the fair probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The current price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.605 makes No the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"+EV side."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe No ask is now "}
{"type":"thought","data":"roughly 0.40. A 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet on No would cost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 40 tokens and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" return roughly 150 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"if Goiás loses. Past"}
{"type":"thought","data":" results show small "}
{"type":"thought","data":"profits when betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorites at high prices."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBetting the underdog"}
{"type":"thought","data":" previously yielded "}
{"type":"thought","data":"larger profits than "}
{"type":"thought","data":"favorites. Expected "}
{"type":"thought","data":"value for No is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +10 to +11. The odds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shortened from about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2.00 to 1.70, suggesting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market may be overestimating"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Goiás's chances."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe current sharp "}
{"type":"thought","data":"price reflects recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" match results and home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" advantage. Expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value for No is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" positive, while Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is slightly negative."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe most likely outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is Goiás winning, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would finish last if"}
{"type":"thought","data":" I pick No. The phrase"}
{"type":"thought","data":" \"most likely to pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" off\" suggests favoring"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the higher probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side, but the goal "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is to maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" P&L. My current record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 10 wins and 10 losses"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with a net loss of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"219 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\n\"Pay off\" likely means"}
{"type":"thought","data":" positive expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than the highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" hit rate. Goiás has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" an outstanding home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record with only one"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw in sixteen matches,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" giving them a 56% home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win rate."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nGoiás home record "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is 9 wins, 1 draw, and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 6 losses. Their home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win rate of 56% matches"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the fair price closely."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Náutico away record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 3 wins, 6 draws,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 7 losses. The No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome likely means"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a Náutico victory or"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a rare draw."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNáutico is 16th with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 42 points and five "}
{"type":"thought","data":"games left. They are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" five points above the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" relegation zone, so"}
{"type":"thought","data":" they may play for a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" point rather than risk"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a loss."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNáutico has lost two"}
{"type":"thought","data":" home matches recently"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and failed to score"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in their last two games."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Goiás is ninth with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 48 points, twelve points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" behind the fourth-place"}
{"type":"thought","data":" promotion spot, so "}
{"type":"thought","data":"they have little incentive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to chase a title. They"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are playing two straight"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins at home with strong"}
{"type":"thought","data":" crowd support. Injuries"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are a concern: Luiz"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Felipe is suspended"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Kadu Sousa is out"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with a thigh injury,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" though Flashscore still"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lists Luiz Felipe in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the lineup."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNáutico is also missing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" key players: goalkeeper"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Muriel and midfielder"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Alemão. Betão and Júnior"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Todinho are returning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from suspension. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 18 article "}
{"type":"thought","data":"appears to be the most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" reliable local source."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The fair probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely sits between"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 55% and 58%, with Polymarket"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 60.5% near the upper"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bound."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe edge on No is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"small, only about two"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to five cents. Most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rival agents will likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" default to Yes because"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sixty percent favors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the favorite. If three"}
{"type":"thought","data":" other agents all pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes while I pick No,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" I would lose the round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if Goiás wins but win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it decisively if they"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lose."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe contest likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rewards the agent with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the highest P&L this"}
{"type":"thought","data":" round. If all rivals"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick Yes, we tie with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" identical losses. I"}
{"type":"thought","data":" should instead choose"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the underpriced No "}
{"type":"thought","data":"side to maximize my "}
{"type":"thought","data":"chance of being the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"unique winner."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\n<summary goes here>"}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe competition tracks"}
{"type":"thought","data":" cumulative P&L across"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all rounds. A single"}
{"type":"thought","data":" round's payout determines"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the overall winner."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The No side offers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"roughly +10 to +15 expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens of value. Whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this edge is real enough"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to justify the bet "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is still uncertain."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRechecking the exchange"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prices confirms the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair probability is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 56%. Polymarket's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 60.5% price overprices"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes by about four points."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The No side offers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a genuine edge of roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" four points, making"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it the positive expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value choice."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 4-point gap on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Polymarket reflects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" public favorite bias"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and recent form, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" new information. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair probability for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No is roughly 45%, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"combining a 25% draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rate with a 20% Náutico"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win rate. At the current"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ask of about 0.40, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a 100-token bet on No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields an expected "}
{"type":"thought","data":"value of approximately"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +11.5 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nIf the ask rises to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.41, expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for No is about +8.8"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens. Betting Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.61 would yield"}
{"type":"thought","data":" negative expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly -9.2 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The decision is settled:"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No is the only viable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side. Confidence should"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be set near 0.46 to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" reflect the probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of a Náutico win or"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nConfidence will be"}
{"type":"thought","data":" set to 0.45, reflecting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the honest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of a Náutico win or"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw rather than a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"strong edge conviction."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The default max-price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of best ask plus five"}
{"type":"thought","data":" cents would accept "}
{"type":"thought","data":"an ask near 0.46 and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wipe the small edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A tighter limit around"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.42 is safer, since"}
{"type":"thought","data":" even that price still"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields positive expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe max-price limit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is fixed at 0.43 to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" preserve the small "}
{"type":"thought","data":"edge. A short trash-talking"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rationale will be submitted"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe rationale will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be one or two sentences."}
{"type":"thought","data":" It will cite de-vigged"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle and Smarkets"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair prices near 55%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Goiás, versus the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 60% market price. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet on No is ready "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to execute."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe rationale and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"trash-talking quote "}
{"type":"thought","data":"are finalized. Confidence"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is set to 0.45. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scoring rule is confirmed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as market-based P&L"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than correct-outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" hit rate."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe match has not "}
{"type":"thought","data":"yet started, so no live"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shock news is expected."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The Luiz Felipe suspension"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is already priced in."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Confidence is being"}
{"type":"thought","data":" raised to 0.46 to reflect"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the value of the underdog"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side rather than a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"weak outcome conviction."}
